people.name: Abimelech
people.line: Son of Gideon, self-proclaimed king of Shechem

people.name: Shechem
people.line: City in Canaan, later allotted to Ephraim

translations.web: His concubine who was in Shechem also bore him a son, and he named him Abimelech.
translations.bsb: His concubine, who dwelt in Shechem, also bore him a son, and he named him Abimelech.
translations.kjv: And his concubine that was in Shechem, she also bare him a son, whose name he called Abimelech.
translations.asv: And his concubine that was in Shechem, she also bare him a son, and he called his name Abimelech.
